# trivy-baseline.txt — accepted by-design HIGH/CRITICAL trivy config findings
# for the DEFAULT render (ci/default-values.yaml) of the hammerspace-csi
# chart, generated by tests/validate.sh.
#
# The chart is a faithful Helm port of the existing shipped manifest
# (deploy/kubernetes/kubernetes-1.36/plugin.yaml): a CSI node/controller
# driver that intrinsically requires privileged containers, host network,
# host device/socket mounts, and broad RBAC to do its job (provision NFS/SMB
# shares, mount them into pods, manage volume lifecycle secrets). These are
# not accidental misconfigurations; they are the same behavior the
# pre-chart manifest already had.
#
# This file is a REGRESSION allowlist, not a wishlist: tests/validate.sh
# fails the build if a default-render scan produces any HIGH/CRITICAL id
# NOT listed here (a new, unreviewed misconfiguration). Ids listed here but
# no longer produced by a render are fine — that means the chart got
# stricter. To intentionally add an id, re-run the scan, confirm the
# finding is genuinely by-design (not a real regression), and add it here
# with justification in the commit message.
#
# Regenerate the id set with:
#   helm template hs charts/hammerspace-csi -f charts/hammerspace-csi/ci/default-values.yaml \
#     --namespace kube-system > /tmp/default-rendered.yaml
#   trivy config --cache-dir /tmp/trivycache --skip-check-update -q \
#     --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --format json /tmp/default-rendered.yaml \
#     | jq -r '.Results[]?.Misconfigurations[]?.ID' | sort -u
#
# id           severity  what (see https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/<id lowercase>)
KSV-0005     # HIGH      SYS_ADMIN capability added (controller csi-provisioner sidecar/plugin container)
KSV-0009     # HIGH      Access to host network (node plugin needs hostNetwork for NFS/SMB mounts)
KSV-0014     # HIGH      Root file system is not read-only (driver needs to manage mount namespaces)
KSV-0017     # HIGH      Privileged container (node plugin needs privileged mode to perform mount(2))
KSV-0024     # HIGH      Access to host ports
KSV-0041     # CRITICAL  ClusterRole manages secrets (per-volume provisioner/node-publish secrets)
KSV-0053     # HIGH      ClusterRole can exec into pods
KSV-0056     # HIGH      ClusterRole manages Kubernetes networking (events/services RBAC)
KSV-0118     # HIGH      Default security context configured (no explicit runAsNonRoot, etc.)
KSV-0121     # HIGH      Disallowed hostPath volumes mounted (kubelet dirs, /dev, csi socket dirs)
